title: lane_presets loader narrows the preset count to u16 without a fail-fast bound — a catalog with >65535 presets silently wraps default_preset_idx / preset_index
detail: The loader rejects out-of-domain weights but never bounds the preset COUNT against the u16 index domain, so >65535 presets silently truncate: default_preset_idx wraps to the wrong preset and higher presets are unreachable via the dial. ODN-5: 'Load-time validation is fail-fast: … out-of-range values … abort startup with a named error.'
recommended_fix: At load, fail-fast when len(b.lane_presets) > 0xFFFF (the u16 wire domain of Cmd_Set_Emphasis.preset), like the weight-domain checks above it.
